intro: I am an economist and policy strategist working at the intersection of central banking, research, and statistics.

Currently, I serve as Executive Director of the Research and Statistics Department at the Czech National Bank (CNB), where I lead analytical, research and statistical teams and contribute to the Bank's forecasting framework and evidence-based policymaking.

My work combines academic research with policy practice, with a focus on monetary policy, financial stability, macro-financial linkages, banking, and the distributional effects of central bank policies. I also work on climate and geopolitical risks and on modernising data and analytical processes in central banking.
